addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 79,256.0, the session high. decisionBox.changed: The stance stays ADD and the structural evidence genuinely improved today, but the honest headline is that the day ended weaker than it traded. THE UPGRADE MIDDAY ASKED FOR ARRIVED: the 4H MACD has crossed POSITIVE - line 52.27 over a 9.28 signal for a +42.98 histogram, against midday's -0.82 - on a 20:00Z close of 78,582.1. That was named at midday as the single cleanest available upgrade signal before this report, and it printed. Everything derivative-side also improved: open interest is 2,144,124,023.82 USD, DOWN a further 0.16 percent from midday's 2,147,628,887.67 while price is flat, so the deleveraging advance continued; funding has collapsed to 0.0000241268054395 per 8h, 37 percent of the midday reading and now barely positive; the perpetual premium DEEPENED its discount to -0.0005307316478582 with mark 78,770.5 sitting 36.1 points UNDER spot; and the OKX retail long/short account ratio printed 1.05 at 00:00Z, the lowest of the entire advance, extending a monotonic slide from 1.15 at midnight through 1.12, 1.10 and now 1.05. Retail has sold every single leg of this move. Against that, three things hold this at range rather than bullish, and they are heavier than they were at midday. First, daily RSI has crossed INTO overbought at 70.82, up from 69.05 - the highest reading of the entire move. Second, the 79,256.0 push failed and the 15m frame has rolled: MACD line -18.80 under a 1.38 signal for a -20.19 histogram, the first negative short-term impulse since the 14:00Z reversal. Third, the macro tape got no friendlier - Brent 91.09 grinding up another 0.66 percent and US10Y up 1.4bp to 4.772 percent. Confidence stays 6.0 rather than rising, because a real upgrade signal that arrives simultaneously with an overbought daily and a failed session high is a wash, not a green light.

overnightRisk: The gap to the next report is roughly 6.5 hours - this file is stamped 19:40 COT and the midnight session runs near 02:00 COT tomorrow - and it covers the 01:00Z-to-07:00Z window, historically the thinnest liquidity of the day. Five specific things sit in it. ONE, and largest: the ETF flow print is INCOMPLETE. Farside has 31 August at a total of +24.2m, but IBIT and HODL are still dashes - and IBIT alone moved +284.4m, +200.8m and +277.6m on the three sessions before Friday's outflow. Whatever IBIT reports overnight will swamp the +24.2m currently on the board and can flip the day either way; a second consecutive outflow print after Friday's -201.9m would be the bearish catalyst with the clearest path into a thin book. TWO: daily RSI at 70.82 is now genuinely overbought for the first time in this advance, and it is overbought after a failed push at 79,256.0. Overnight sessions are where an overextended daily mean-reverts, because there is nobody there to defend it. THREE: the downside liquidation shelf is heavy and close-packed - 78,250 holds 1,393,039 USD, 78,000 holds 1,969,105 USD and 78,500 holds 2,681,420 USD. A break of the 78,402.1 session low into overnight liquidity has three magnets stacked underneath it inside 400 points, and the daily ATR of 2,312.12 says a single normal session covers all of them and more. FOUR: Brent at 91.09 has now added roughly 3.2 percent across two sessions, and the Asian session is where an energy-shock repricing of rate expectations tends to show up first. FIVE: the 1 September cost-of-living charge lands on the wallet at the midnight session, so the book will be paying 30 USDT out of savings and cash regardless of what price does. WHY THE STOP ORDER IS NOT RECOMMENDED DESPITE ALL OF THAT: the futures book is FLAT and the spot core is unlevered, so there is no position in this wallet that can be liquidated overnight and no margin that can be called. A resting stop on a long-term DCA stack would convert a paper drawdown into a realized loss at the worst hour of the day, which is the opposite of what the stack is for. The 78,350.0 level is published as the REDUCE reference for the midnight session to act on with a settled close, not as a resting order. If a futures position were open, this recommendation would be true and the stop would sit at 78,350.0.

calibration.rollingRecord: 31 August, four sessions: midnight add-gate fired and lost (acting_helped false), morning reduce-gate fired falsely and cost 1,066 points of upside (false), midday reduce-gate correctly did NOT fire while the add-gate fired and round-tripped (false), endday pending. Three graded sessions, zero wins - but the failure mode has changed shape and that is the finding.
calibration.note: The midday gates are the first pair this desk has built outside the 0.4-to-0.6 ATR whipsaw band, and the result is measurable. The REDUCE gate at 78,200.0 did NOT fire: the session low was 78,402.1, a 202-point margin, where the morning's narrower 77,950.0 gate had fired on a 234-point overshoot and then watched price rally 1,163 points. That is the fix working. The ADD gate at 79,000.0 DID fire, cleanly, on the 18:00Z close of 79,013.1 - and it did not pay. Price extended 243 points to 79,256.0 and then gave it all back; spot is 78,806.6, which is 56.0 points BELOW the midday tranche at 78,862.6. So acting_helped is graded false, but the two failures are not the same failure. The morning's was a placement error - the gate was in the noise band and the noise triggered it. The midday one is a follow-through error - the gate was correctly placed, the signal was real, and the market simply did not extend. The lesson being carried into the endday gates is that this is now the THIRD add-gate in a row that confirmed properly and failed to pay: 78,300 at midnight, 78,800 at morning (unfired), 79,000 at midday. Every one of them pointed at a round number or a recent high with a consumed short cluster immediately above it. The endday add gate has therefore been set at 79,256.0 - the actual failure high - rather than at a round number, on the reasoning that the level worth requiring a close above is the one that has already rejected price.
